d: A deadly train collision in Spain has killed at least 69 people and injured 80 others after a high-speed train slammed into a stationary train. Investigators are examining a possible signalling failure and whether negligence or safety lapses played a role. The crash has renewed scrutiny of Spain’s railway safety, following another deadly train accident earlier this year. What caused the collision, and could it have been prevented? Palki Sharma tells you.
